propositions: rebar fsck and rebar compact-all traverse all ticket directories regardless of archival state, causing O(n) walks dominated by archived tickets; default scoping should skip archived tickets and require explicit --include-archived to include them
rebar archive writes only the ARCHIVED event and marker but leaves the ticket's event log unfolded; archived tickets carry unfolded tails until a later compact-all sweep visits them
archive operation should perform a terminal fold (with threshold=0 and horizon=0) inline before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring just-archived tickets have complete SNAPSHOTs covering all events
The shared _ticket_dirs iterator helper should decide archival state using both .archived marker fast-path and _is_net_archived confirmation to prevent false negatives on reverted-archive tickets

Default fsck and compact-all with active-only scoping must still support deep audit and legacy-ticket folding via --include-archived flag and preserve store-wide metrics (authorship tallies, signed/unsigned counts)
Archive-time terminal fold must capture and propagate fold errors to CommandError without writing ARCHIVED marker or .archived file on fold failure
